description:
Approve one pending steering rule so it reaches the iteration prompts.

    Pass the project id and the rule `id` from list_steering_rules. Only a
    `pending` rule changes; an already active rule returns `changed: false`.
    A retired rule is refused (409): approval never re-activates it. Your
    identity comes from this connection and is recorded on the audit trail.
name: approve_steering_rule
title: Approve Steering Rule
